new_assertions.title: observed transporter-sign projection is non-injective
new_assertions.body: On the two shortest 5x4 routes, distinct represented full-transporter identities 197500 and 197501 have the same accumulated permutation-sign bit 1.

new_assertions.title: support alone does not determine distinguished source residual membership
new_assertions.body: The shared support identity 197600 does not determine the P0 membership bit of residual token 197700 across source sheets 197400 and 197401.

new_assertions.title: source quotient is non-injective for represented residual content
new_assertions.body: Quotient node 197000 contains at least two fine source sheets with different represented P0 residual-membership content.

new_assertions.title: target quotient is non-injective for represented residual content
new_assertions.body: Quotient node 197002 contains at least two fine final residual states with different represented P0 residual-membership content.

new_assertions.title: quotient endpoints do not determine route phase
new_assertions.body: For the shortest 5x4 obstruction, the ordered quotient endpoint pair (197000,197002) is compatible with route phase 0 and route phase 1; route phase is not a function of those quotient endpoints alone.

new_assertions.title: quotient endpoints do not determine accumulated full transporter
new_assertions.body: For the same quotient endpoint pair (197000,197002), the two shortest 5x4 routes carry distinct accumulated full-transporter identities.

new_assertions.title: quotient endpoints do not determine oriented action history
new_assertions.body: For the same quotient endpoint pair (197000,197002), the two shortest 5x4 routes carry distinct source-frame action-sequence identities.

new_assertions.title: binary-tie stabilizer relation is Boolean equality
new_assertions.body: For represented Boolean bits x,y, BINARY_TIE_ALLOWED(x,y) holds exactly when x=y.
new_assertions.scope: guarded all-binary-tie orientation relation represented in packet

new_assertions.title: constant-zero node assignment satisfies the concrete 4x4 reconvergence
new_assertions.body: Assigning Boolean 0 to every represented node 197010..197015 satisfies every edge equation in both concrete 4x4 witness routes.

new_assertions.title: shortest 5x4 closed route difference has odd delta parity
new_assertions.body: XORing the four represented edge-delta bits from the two shortest 5x4 routes gives 1.

new_assertions.title: concrete 4x4 route difference has zero delta parity
new_assertions.body: XORing the six represented edge-delta bits from the two explicit 4x4 routes gives 0.

support_refinements.witness: Exhaust all 2^4 assignments to one Boolean value on quotient nodes 197000,197001,197003,197002. None satisfies the four edge equations simultaneously.
support_refinements.note: SC-E013 remains source-explicit; this adds independent primitive implicit support without rewriting provenance.

rejected_candidates.body: Residual incidence explains all 25 5x4 nonzero syndromes.

rejected_candidates.body: The full accumulated transporter is the intrinsic corrected phase.
